name: list_issues
description: List Linear issues with optional state, project, label and assignee filters. With no filters, lists your open issues (assigned to you, excluding completed and cancelled).

state.description: Filter by workflow state name, e.g. 'In Progress'. Defaults to any open state (completed and cancelled are excluded).

assignee.description: Filter by assignee name, or 'me' for yourself, or 'anyone' for all assignees. Defaults to you.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default 25, maximum 250).
